### Bible Pathways 02/01/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-01-or-2002-1127422.html
Passage: Leviticus 3:3
Points:
- The peace offering was a voluntary sacrifice of thanksgiving where God's portion was always honored first.
- It uniquely fostered fellowship, being shared among the altar, the priests, and the worshiper's family.
- Believers justified through faith have peace with God, but many fail to experience His inner peace.
- Experiencing God's peace requires surrendering one's thought life and mind entirely to Christ.
- Presenting our bodies as living sacrifices serves as our peace offering to walk in harmony with God.
